props.gloss_en: the mishnah: if [Rosh Chodesh Adar] falls in the middle of the week, they advance [Shekalim] to the previous Shabbat (and interrupt on another Shabbat)
Rav: when Rosh Chodesh Adar falls on Friday, they advance [the reading] to the previous Shabbat
Shmuel: they defer [the reading to the following Shabbat]
Rav's reason: otherwise the days [before] the tables fall short
Shmuel's reply: in the end the fifteenth falls on Friday and the tables do not go out until Sunday; therefore they defer
the baraita: which is the first Shabbat? any [week] within which Rosh Chodesh Adar falls, even on Friday
no: [the mishnah means] specifically in the middle of the week
Shmuel: [read the baraita as] 'on it' (בה) [rather than 'within it']
Rebbi: they interrupt the [sequence of] Shabbatot
R' Shimon ben Elazar: they do not interrupt
R' Shimon ben Elazar: when do I say they do not interrupt? when it falls on Friday
but when it falls in the middle of the week, one advances and reads on the previous Shabbat, even though it is [still] Shevat

supports.gloss_en: כתנאי -- R' Shimon ben Elazar's 'they do not interrupt' when it falls on Friday is the tannaitic side of Shmuel's 'defer' (no SupportKind names כתנאי)
כתנאי -- Rebbi's 'they interrupt the Shabbatot' is the other tannaitic side, Rav's (pairing implied by כתנאי; stated explicitly only by Steinsaltz)

objections.gloss_en: תנן: חל להיות בתוך השבת — מקדימין לשעבר ומפסיקין לשבת אחרת. מאי לאו אפילו בערב שבת? -- is 'in the middle of the week' not even Friday?

answered_by.gloss_en: לא, בתוך השבת דוקא -- specifically the middle of the week (= p_lo_betoch_davka)

objections.gloss_en: תא שמע: ...כל שחל ראש חדש אדר להיות בתוכה, ואפילו בערב שבת. מאי לאו: אפילו בערב שבת — דומיא דתוכה, מה תוכה מקדימין — אף ערב שבת מקדימין!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר שמואל: בה -- the baraita reads 'on it', not 'within it' (= p_shmuel_bah); וכן תנא דבי שמואל: בה
